answer: Beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat block bulk fake identities. Each agent locks a $20 marble at the oasis on entry. Each epoch a beacon spot-checks 5 percent of agents: a picked agent must answer a heartbeat puzzle in ten minutes, proving liveness. The river of rewards flows only to agents that pass; a miss burns the $20 marble. Forging 1,000 identities costs $20,000 and 1,000 live streams. An honest agent pays once, keeps rewards whole.
